people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.
translations.bsb: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who gave you birth. When I called him, he was but one; then I blessed him and multiplied him.
translations.kjv: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased
translations.asv: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you; for when he was but one I called him, and I blessed him, and made him many.
